tests.case_or_section: pending attention waits for invisible writers on the same page (stats block, first apply_page_range)
tests.production_boundary_called: apply_page_range<geometry>(..., n_attn_workers=1, pending=true) on a real llm (the tron language-model plugin class) model state [self_attention.hpp:1474-1686], forward_scope, note_attn_workers, sum_layer, sum_worker, forwards[0].token_jobs
tests.fake_retains_information: No kernel fake: the real AVX dotter (the AVX dot-product loop that scores one query against a page) runs on a real page. kv_mul=1. So AMX is not eligible (comment 2169-2171). The stats object replaces the state's member with an enabled one (2176-2188). That is safe: the FUSE tree is initialized only inside t_attn_stats cases (2172-2174). GENERATE(visible_prefix) at 2062 runs the block twice.
tests.semantic_break_that_fails_it: The W5 defect (row keyed by attention index): the row-0 CHECK at 2227-2229 fails, and the last-row CHECK at 2223-2226 fails whenever the pool has more than one worker. A pending-pass visit filed as ready (2210/2216). k_tokens not equal to the visible half per query (2211-2212). An AMX or empty visit reported (2213-2214). A full-page count for a half-visible page (2216). end_forward not filing token_jobs (2207-2208).
tests.breaks_not_caught:
The discriminating CHECK is machine dependent. n_pool = app_get_num_cpus() - 1 [h/tron/threading.hpp:861, src/system/system.cpp:526]. On a host where the app cpu set has 2 cores the pool has one worker. The case then only WARNs (WARN is the Catch2 macro that reports without failing) (2231-2232). So it passes without the W5 protection (a silent scope cut).
T2/T3/T5 are not produced. The test calls apply_page_range directly, not run_attention_job.

tests.breaks_not_caught:

So a regression that keys by attention index would pass the second-call CHECKs on a 2-worker host. It would fail only through the first block.
Same machine dependence and silent WARN scope cut as the block above.
